description: Source code for the PrettyDiff command class, which generates and displays a pretty diff in a web browser, including methods for executing the command, generating diffs, and opening the diff in a browser.

classes.name: PrettyDiff
classes.description: A command class that shows a pretty diff in the default browser.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the PrettyDiff command with options for git commit.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the pretty diff command, prompts user for confirmation.

methods.name: _show_pretty_diff
methods.description: Generates and displays the pretty diff, handles errors.

methods.name: _diff
methods.description: Creates a patch for the specified git commit.

methods.name: _open_pretty_diff
methods.description: Opens the generated diff in the default browser or via cygstart on Cygwin.
